name: Malem Pendant
summary: The Malem Pendant is found in a wagon in Desolace. Vahlarriel Demonslayer at Nijel’s Point needs it, along with news of tracks leading south.

sections.title: A Sign in the Wagon
sections.body: Footprints lead south from the wagon where you find the Malem Pendant. Smoke rises from a nearby fort, and its steady fire suggests people are there. Vahlarriel Demonslayer at Nijel’s Point needs to see the pendant and hear what you found.

faq.q: Where do I take the Malem Pendant?
faq.answer: Take the Malem Pendant to Vahlarriel Demonslayer at Nijel’s Point in Desolace.
You find the Malem Pendant in a wagon in Desolace.

faq.q: What clues were near the pendant?
faq.answer: Footprints lead south from the wagon, and smoke rises from a nearby fort.

faq.q: Why does Vahlarriel need to hear about the fort?
faq.answer: Vahlarriel is searching for the Malems, and the tracks and smoke suggest they may have been taken toward the fort.
